message: Accessing the static interface member '{0}' is not supported on the compile-time template type parameter '{1}'. Call a run-time generic method that accesses the member instead, or make the type parameter run-time.
rationale: The message lacks the article before 'compile-time template type parameter' and gives no way forward, although the member can be accessed from a run-time generic helper method or through a run-time type parameter (TemplateAnnotator.VisitMemberAccessExpression).
